message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie count can vary slightly depending on size and variety:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 15 kcal  |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22 kcal  |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 33 kcal  |

These values are for raw, fresh tomatoes. Cooking or adding sauces will change the total calorie content.
